newsitem.title: USA: Semiconductor Laser dedicates Binghamton plant.
newsitem.headline: Semiconductor Laser dedicates Binghamton plant.

text.p: Semiconductor Laser International Corp said Friday it has dedicated the first phase of its new manufacturing facility, where the company plans to employ a staff of up to 400 by 1999 when Phase III is fully operational.
The company said the Binghamton area has been hit by job losses, but is now seeing a resurgence in the manufacturing sector, thanks in part to its new plant.

The 15,000 square foot facility began production in February on a technologically unique type of high power semiconductor diode laser, which the company said provides improved efficiency, power and durability to end-users, at lower cost.

SLI said that because of the large number of orders it is already working on Phase II of the plant, which when completed near the end of 1997, will double the size of the facility to 30,000 square foot.
Semiconductor Laser International produces its laser products for automotive, dental, medical, telecommunications, data storage, printing and military applications.
